status: planning-only; parent confirmation is required before host configuration, indexing, or deployment

retiredPublicPreview.policy: Not publicly routed or mapped to a host. Preserve repository history/source archive; server retirement is parent-owned.

verticalCatalogue.hostPolicy: One canonical subdomain per profile, rendered by one shared marketing build. No copied per-vertical backend, login, or business store.

sourceCaveats.tradepilot: Use layout only. Do not carry over unverified metrics, live/demo claims, signup forms, integrations, login links, or media with unresolved provenance.
sourceCaveats.personalServices: Use as the source for the .pro managed-service design. Its current one-page donor is not the final multi-page site; verify or omit customer stories, metrics, third-party contact/payment/booking paths, tracking and form behavior.
sourceCaveats.otherDonors: FieldCrew and older donor pages are excluded from this host plan unless separately reviewed and approved.

sharedBoundaries: Marketing websites remain separate from apps/web and never become runtime dependencies.
All marketing login links target the canonical app host and contain no bearer credentials.
Do not share cookies indiscriminately between .io and .pro.
Marketing content must match catalogue evidence; planned workflows are labeled and unavailable workflows are not presented as functional.
Review builds remain noindex until the parent approves the complete deployment plan and host-specific sitemap/robots strategy.
